description: This file defines an API for managing collections of object identifiers (OIDs), including functions for adding, searching, sorting, filtering, and iterating over the OID sets. It is used for efficient storage and manipulation of large lists of object IDs in a software project, likely a version control or object management system.

methods.name: oid_array_append
methods.description: Adds an object ID to the array, potentially reallocating memory and losing order.

methods.name: oid_array_lookup
methods.description: Performs a binary search for a specific object ID within the array, sorting it if necessary.

methods.name: oid_array_clear
methods.description: Frees memory and resets the array to an initial empty state.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each
methods.description: Iterates over each object ID in the array, executing a callback function.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each_unique
methods.description: Iterates over each unique object ID in the sorted array, executing a callback function.

methods.name: oid_array_filter
methods.description: Retains only elements for which a callback function returns true, preserving order.

methods.name: oid_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts the array in ascending order of object IDs.

methods.name: size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array * array,size_t cur)
methods.description: Returns the index of the next unique object ID after a given position in the sorted array.

ctags.name: oid_array_next_unique
ctags.pattern: /^static inline size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array *array, size_t cur)$/
